extracted.intended_audience: state agencies, regulated entities, attorneys, journalists, and members of the public who use or monitor Texas rulemaking notices and open meetings
extracted.subtask_description: Information about the Texas Register: what types of rulemaking and related documents are published, how often and in what formats, where back issues and search tools are available, and the Secretary of State's disclaimer about posted content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose and role of the Texas Register
rubrics_metrics.description: A weekly publication, the Texas Register serves as the journal of state agency rulemaking for Texas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Texas Register as the official public record for agency rulemaking actions and related notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of information published
rubrics_metrics.description: Information published in the Texas Register includes proposed, adopted, withdrawn, and emergency rule actions, notices of state agency review of agency rules, governor's appointments, attorney general opinions, and miscellaneous documents such as requests for proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions to the Register should fall into one of these categories (or other miscellaneous documents recognized by the Register) to be published here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication frequency and posting deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Issues are posted to the website no later than 5 p.m. on the publication day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect new issues on a weekly schedule and plan filings or monitoring accordingly to meet or observe the posting deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-adoption codification
rubrics_metrics.description: After adoption, these rulemaking actions are codified into the Texas Administrative Code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopted rules published in the Register will later appear in the Texas Administrative Code (TAC); consult the TAC for codified rule text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Available formats and access points
rubrics_metrics.description: Current Issue (HTML | PDF); Previous Issues (HTML | PDF); RSS Feeds; Indexes (HTML | PDF); University of North Texas Libraries Back Issue Archive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users may access the Register in HTML or PDF, subscribe via RSS, or search historical issues through the provided search tool and external archives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search coverage and historical range
rubrics_metrics.description: Search the Texas Register (includes January 28, 2000 - current issues).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The built-in search covers issues from Jan 28, 2000 forward; use the UNT Back Issue Archive for material predating or supplementing the search range.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibility and accuracy disclaimer for posted content
rubrics_metrics.description: The Secretary of State is not responsible for the information or content that is contained in Texas Register notices. Nor does the SOS make any representations as to sufficiency or accuracy of the posted information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Postings are submitted electronically by outside parties; direct any questions about a particular posting to the submitting entity. Contact information is included in each posted document.
